rachel (platform): fyi alert from leak-detect: found a KMS-wrapped blob in partner-archive with metadata pointing at our keyring. path: gs://partner-archive/2026-03-23/export.enc :grimacing:
nina (sec): can you paste the ciphertext header? any principal in object ACLs?
rachel (platform): header shows: `KMS:projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap-v1` object ACL: OWNER: partner-team@partner.com, READER: allUsers (??) — looks like bucket ACL had a public read grant (weird)
ajay (infra): public read on partner bucket is bad. but public read + wrapped key doesn't mean they can decrypt. need to check key IAM and audit logs. running: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partner-wrap-v1 --location=us-central1 --keyring=partners`
audit-bot: KMS data access logs for partner-wrap-v1 show GetCryptoKeyVersion, Encrypt calls on 2026-03-22 21:11 from serviceAccount:partner-import@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
tim (oncall): who owns partner-import SA? tagging @ajay to check recent runner grants.
ajay (infra): partner-import is granted to terraform module partner-ingest-runner -> ephemeral pool. I'll grep TF state for any third-party principals.
nina (sec): plan proposal: 1) quarantine copy of object to internal-only bucket 2) disable public ACL on partner bucket 3) audit KMS grants and remove any non-internal principals 4) create per-partner key policy recommendation 5) enable key-level Data Access logs to sink for 90d 6) consider rewrap if any risky principals found
rachel (platform): agreed. quick Q: can we disable public read without breaking partner ingestion? partner expects us to upload archives to their bucket currently. maybe switch to uploading to our internal archive and push to partner via signed URL.
ajay (infra): we should avoid partners holding wrapped ciphertext keyed to our master key. longer-term: provision a dedicated key per partner or require partner-managed KMS key. short-term: remove public ACL and rotate the wrapping key used for uploads last 48h.
audit-bot: note: no direct `serviceAccount:partner@external` in key bindings. only `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `group:infra-admins@redwood.com` with admin roles.
nina (sec): excellent — blast radius limited. still rewrap to new key `partner-wrap-v2` with restricted encrypter role only to rewrap-runner SA. ajay, can you prepare TF PR for new key and a narrow IAM binding?
ajay (infra): will open PR `infra/kms/partners/2026-03-23-dedicated-key` and include plan to create partner-wrap-v2, add serviceAccount:rewrap-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter only during rewrap window, then remove it.
tim (oncall): I'll hold quarantine and run smoke decrypt after rewrap. also will schedule a short maintenance window 02:30 UTC.
rachel (platform): I've removed public ACL on bucket and created signed-uploads workflow for partner ingestion. sending docs to partners now.
vault-bot: Reminding: store rewrap manifest in Vault path `secret/incidents/INC-2026-03-23-02/rewrap-manifest` and record key version used.
nina (sec): i'll create INC-2026-03-23-02 and kick off a repo scan for any accidental inclusion of plaintext keys or wrap key names. if repo hits, rotate tokens immediately and follow creds-rotation playbook.
ajay (infra): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1999 opened. includes terraform, IAM least-priv changes, and documented rewrap steps (gcloud example).
audit-bot: action item logged: enable audit sink for KMS Data Access -> projects/redwood-logs/sinks/longterm-audit (90d retention) by rachel (platform).
tim (oncall): final checklist for window: - copy object to gs://quarantine-private/ - create `partner-wrap-v2` and limit IAM - run rewrap job via rewrap-runner - smoke decrypt in staging - rotate any tokens if repo-scan finds leaks - commit onboarding change to require internal-only storage or per-partner keys
nina (sec): also add RBAC question to next sec-sync: should infra-admins have cloudkms.admin? might be overbroad. propose split: infra-operators (no admin) + infra-admins (guarded with MFA & approval).
rachel (platform): ack. I'll update partner onboarding checklist and notify partner of short maintenance.
ajay (infra): merging PR after green CI, will notify team in this thread when rewrap complete.
tim (oncall): i'll be on-call for the window. closing for now; follow-ups in INC-2026-03-23-02. :thumbsup:
